Name: (CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Kitchen
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=3][b]Cozy Rustic Kitchen [/b]is a modern rustic kitchen redesign with gingham accents that comes in various styles. Choose between the classic wood grain countertop, a chic patterned tile countertop, or a classy metal countertop - and mix-and-match until you find the perfect color scheme!

🌿 This mod is part of the [b]Cozy Rustic Interior[/b] revamp series! 🌿
Find the rest of the series: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Farmhouse [/url]﻿| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30070]Cellar[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30170/]Greenhouse[/url]

🌿 Need matching [b]Cozy Rustic Furniture[/b]? [url=https://emojipedia.org/herb#:~:text=An%20herb%2C%20a%20plant%20used,with%20five%20or%20seven%20leaves.]🌿
[/url]Find them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33316]Buildable Kitchen[/url]﻿ | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33318]Bakery n' Cafe[/url][/size][/center]
[img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]
[size=3]
[list]
[*][b]Farmhouse and Cabin Kitchen Replacement: [/b]This mod retextures your farmhouse and cabin kitchen to match the Cozy Rustic theme.
[*][b](NEW!) Cabin Kitchen Config: [/b]Cabin kitchen retexture can be separately configured from the Farmhouse kitchen now using a new set of config options.﻿
[*][b]Highly Customizable: [/b]3 countertop styles, 2 cabinet styles, 9 wood swatches, 4 tile swatches 6 metal swatches, 6 accent swatches... everything can be seamlessly combined. The possibilities are endless!
[*][b]Vanilla-Matching Wood Swatches: [/b]The basic wood tones includes the 4 Vanilla wood colors (Oak, Walnut, Birch, Mahogany) and comes with an extra 5 custom swatches.
[*][b]Mini-Fridge Retexture: [/b]Has a toggleable Mini-Fridge replacement. Configurable style, color, and accent color!
[*][b]Alternative Textures option: [/b]The Mini-Fridge retexture also comes with an AT version. For more details, see the [b]Mod Contents [/b]section below.
[*][b]More to Come: [/b]Check out the [b]Future Plans [/b]section!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img]

[size=3][b]Farmhouse/Cabin Kitchen Replacement
[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]As it says on the tin, replaces kitchen texture in your farmhouse and cabins.
[*]The color of your cabinets will always match the base counter color.
[*]The color of the tile accents when using the Tile countertop will always match the gingham accent colors.
[*]Image references for configs are included in the file archive you download.
[/list]
[b][size=3]Mini-Fridge Retexture
[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Comes in a CP and AT version. The CP version is packaged with the main kitchen files in [b](CP) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Kitchen Replacement [/b]folder, while the AT version is in [b](AT) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Mini Fridges.[/b]
[*]You can safely remove the AT version from your mods folder anytime.
[*]I've provided the AT version as a standalone download in case you deleted it and changed your mind, or want to use it in another mod folder setup... you do you.
[*]The CP version comes in two styles, while AT version comes in 4 (the additional two can be used on two adjacent Mini-Fridges to make a double-door fridge).
[/list]
[b]If you want to change the color of the radio on top of the Mini-sized AT version, you have to do it manually. [/b]This is due to how Alternative Textures works. If for some reason you disabled the Mini-Fridge retexture in the CP version and want to match the radio color to the rest of your wood items, do the following:

[spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Go to Mods/(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Kitchen/(AT) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Mini Fridges/Textures/Overlays.
[*]Open the MiniRadio image file you want to overlay [b]in an image-editing software that allows transparency [/b](e.g. Aseprite, CSP, GIMP, etc.).
[*]Select the whole canvas and copy (Ctrl + C).
[*]Go to Mods/(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Kitchen/(AT) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Mini Fridges/Textures/Mini-Fridge.
[*]Paste (Ctrl + V) the overlay you copied [b]into all texture files that has the Mini-sized fridge [/b]i.e. texture_2, 6, 10, 14, 18, and 22.png. Don't forget to save for every file.
[*]Voila, radio color changed.
[*]Why would you do this when you can just[b] Enable Mini-Fridge Retexture in the main mod, set the size to Mini, configure the radio colors through GMCM[/b], THEN use the AT version for the other 3 fridge retextures to make your life easier? (At least now you know the difficult way to do things!)
[/list][/spoiler]

[i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img]
[/i]
These config options are available across both the [b]Farmhouse Kitchen [/b]and [b]Cabin Kitchen [/b]config categories:

[list]
[*][b]Base Color: [/b]Toggles the color of your kitchen counter and cabinets.
[*][b]Cabinet Style: [/b]Toggles between a Plain and Stripey cabinet.
[*][b]Countertop Material: [/b]Toggles between a Wood, Tile, or Metal countetop.
[*][b]Kitchen Appliance Color: [/b]Toggles the color of your kitchen appliances.
[*][b]Enable Mini-Fridge Replacement: [/b]Toggles a texture replacement for the Mini-Fridge. [b]Set to false if using other mods that replace the Mini-Fridge texture.[/b]
[*][b]Sink Tile Color: [/b]Toggles the sink tile color when using Wood countertop.
[*][b]Wood Countertop Color: [/b]Toggles the Wood countertop color.
[*][b]Tile Countertop Color: [/b]Toggles the Tile countertop color.
[*][b]Metal Countertop Color: [/b]Toggles the Metal countertop color.
[*][b]Handle Color: [/b]Toggles the handle color on all cabinets and counters.
[*][b]Gingham Color: [/b]Toggles the color of the gingham accents and, when using the Tile countertop, the tile accents.
[/list]
The following configs will not take effect [b]if Enable Mini-Fridge Replacement is set to false:
[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Mini-Fridge Style: [/b]Toggles the Mini-Fridge appearance.
[*][b]Mini-Fridge Color: [/b]Toggles the Mini-Fridge color.
[*][b]Mini-Mini-Fridge Radio Color: [/b]Toggles the radio color on top of the Mini-Mini-Fridge. (That's a lot of Minis.)
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img]

[u][b]Compatible[/b] [/u]with custom farmhouses. However, the kitchen may look wonky if your custom farmhouse's kitchen doesn't have certain tiles placed next to each other (namely, the stove and the counter to its left in farmhouse_tiles.png.
[b]
[u]Conditionally Compatible[/u][/b] with other mods that replace the Mini-Fridge textures. You may need to set [b]Enable Mini-Fridge Replacement [/b]to false.

[u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with other kitchen replacement mods or other mods that edit the kitchen tiles in farmhouse_tiles.png (such as Industrial Interior). v 1.0.2 made this mod have the Late patch priority so it overrides similar mods, but I cannot guarantee this will prevent all of them from editing the same assets.[size=3]
[/size]
﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ [/b](if you want to use the AT version).
[*]Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (not required, but VERY recommended for ease of configuration).
[*]Download and unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Kitchen" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me, but I cannot guarantee I can fix them.
[/list]
[b]Please prioritize reporting any bugs on the Nexus page and follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.[/b]

[b][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/dkyXBMw/future-plans.png[/img][/b]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Separate island farmhouse kitchen retexture.[/size]
[*][size=2][s]Separated configs for the farmhouse and cabin kitchens... maybe... if it's not too much...[/s] (ADDED IN v.2.0.0!)[/size]
[*][size=2][s]A modular, buildable version with kitchen islands, clutter and more![/s] (NOW AS A STANDALONE MOD!)[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img]
